name: high-score
description: Reach the HIGH-SCORE NAME ENTRY screen (game over with a qualifying score), drive the entry (LEFT held from the first letter, RIGHT, fire), then start a 2-player game from the entry screen, and pixel-validate it vs MAME.
_grounding: Same game-over recipe (lives 0xAD00/0xAD10=1 @650, forced death 0xA800=0xF0 @660) PLUS a held score poke 0xAD33/34/35 = 00/57/00 (5700 BCD, beats the default table-low 4300) from f640. At f1134 the insertion sort (isScoreBelow 0x4d2b + fileScoreIntoHighScoreTable 0x4cc3) files 5700 into the last table record at 0xAB28, and name entry holds ~680 frames. Responded uses the FILED score mid-byte 0xAB2A (0x43 default -> 0x57 only once the game files the poked score); the grounding's 0xAB2F==0xF1 is weak (the default record already ends in 0xF1). Deterministic, no entropy. Inputs in entry: LEFT held f1200-1270 steps INITIALS_LETTER_INDEX 0xA999 back from 0, wrapping to 26 and auto-repeating while held (INITIALS_BACK_PRESS_HISTORY 0xA995 saturates and is re-armed); RIGHT f1300 steps it forward; fire f1330/f1380 and LEFT f1360. Coin f1420, coin 2 f1460 and 2 Players Start f1520 start a 2P game from the entry screen (stepHighScoreInitialsEntry -> startTwoPlayerGame, golden ~f1522).
